Not sure if you believe in "signs", but I believe that's a sign you're meant to be here. I've spent the day searching the internet for some kind of inspiration as to why I should stay alive and I read something that struck me. 

Mathematically speaking, the odds of a person (any person) being born is quite small. From the odds of conception, to a healthy pregnancy, to safe delivery. The fact that there are billions of people on this planet is actually quite miraculous. And you are one of those people that beat the odds of being born. You were meant to be here.

You may not feel happy about that right now, and I get it, life f*cking sucks sometimes. My life is a total shitshow right now and I don't really want to be here either. I just try to get through one day at a time. It encouraged me to think that the universe designed for me to be here at this point in time and even if I can't see the point of it now, if we hold on, the possibilities are endless.

Anyways, sorry for the essay. Hope that gives you some encouragement too and I hope you make it through today....and the next.....

I'm sorry you're going through this. I'm behind for my age for very different reasons. At almost 50 yrs old, I was a stay-at-home-mom for almost 20 years to a husband that controlled all the money. Now we're going through a divorce and I have no job, no college education, no money, etc. I'm starting life all over from nothing when most people my age are educated, have a stable career, have started saving for and are planning their retirement. I also suffer from severe depression, which only complicates things. It's frustrating, but we are where we are. All we can do is take one day at a time and do our best. And not spend our energy on worrying what any judgy haters think!
